# /seo:data

This legacy Claude Code command selects mode `data` from the
canonical [skills/seo/SKILL.md](../skills/seo/SKILL.md) workflow.

Pass `$ARGUMENTS` unchanged to that mode. The canonical skill owns validation,
defaults, resources, safety rules, stop conditions, and artifact paths.

Established usage:

```text
/seo:data [type] [arguments]
```
